units.source_zh: 秀吉目空一切，热情奔放，甚至可说有些疯狂。

units.source_en: Such was his nature, and his exalted position as kampaku made him more unbridled still.
units.source_zh: 他本性如此，再加上身处关白高位，更是肆无忌惮。

units.source_en: When he clapped his hands, Hidenaga led in a girl of twelve or thirteen, still as green and unripe as a young plum.
units.source_zh: 他拍手后，秀长带进一个十二三岁的女子，那女子还如同一颗青梅。

units.source_en: Ieyasu was bewildered.

paragraphs.source_en: “I do not know.”

paragraphs.source_zh: “不知。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Of course—you could hardly know! A descendant of that worthy elder has also come here on this occasion. He is Torii Hikoemon Mototada, castellan of Kōfu and a senior Tokugawa retainer! Am I right, brother-in-law?”

units.source_en: “Of course—you could hardly know!
units.source_zh: “是啊，你怎会明白！

paragraphs.source_zh: “是啊，你怎会明白！这位长者之后此次也来了。他便是甲府城代、德川重臣鸟居彦右卫门元忠！我说得可对，亲家兄弟？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes.”

units.source_en: “Yes.”

paragraphs.source_en: “And Mototada’s son is this young man carrying the great sword. I shall act as matchmaker and make him your son-in-law. You have no legitimate son. With this arrangement, your house will be secure as well. What do you say?”

units.source_en: “And Mototada’s son is this young man carrying the great sword.
units.source_zh: “而元忠之子，就是这个持大刀的年轻人。

paragraphs.source_zh: “而元忠之子，就是这个持大刀的年轻人。我来做媒，让他给你做女婿。你无嫡子，这样一来，家中也自安泰，怎样？”

paragraphs.source_en: Hidenaga looked calmly at Shintarō. His daughter was not yet grown and her face was suffused with shyness. Ieyasu could not help turning to glance at the deeply uncomfortable Shintarō.

units.source_en: Hidenaga looked calmly at Shintarō.

units.source_zh: 家康忍不住回头看了一眼很不自在的新太郎。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀长平静地看着新太郎。他的女儿尚未成人，满面含羞。家康忍不住回头看了一眼很不自在的新太郎。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ha ha! Hidenaga, this young man is utterly unruffled—he does not even blink. If you do not give him your daughter, whom else could you possibly give her to? We shall discuss it further in Osaka. For now, take the little girl away.” Hideyoshi spoke with his customary breezy unconcern.

units.source_en: “Ha ha! Hidenaga, this young man is utterly unruffled—he does not even blink.
units.source_zh: “哈哈，秀长，这个年轻人毫不在意，连眼也不眨一眨。

paragraphs.source_zh: “哈哈，秀长，这个年轻人毫不在意，连眼也不眨一眨。你不把女儿许给他，还能许给谁？此事到大坂再议，先带小丫头退下吧。”秀吉大咧咧道。

paragraphs.source_en: After Hidenaga withdrew, Hideyoshi turned the conversation back to women and asked Ieyasu with a smile, “What sort of woman do you like—the stubborn and fierce kind, or the gentle and refined?”

units.source_en: After Hidenaga withdrew, Hideyoshi turned the conversation back to women and asked Ieyasu with a smile, “What sort of woman do you like—the stubborn and fierce kind, or the gentle and refined?”
units.source_zh: 秀长退下后，秀吉又把话题转移到女人身上，笑着问家康：“你喜欢什么样的女子，是倔犟剽悍的，还是温柔娴雅的？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀长退下后，秀吉又把话题转移到女人身上，笑着问家康：“你喜欢什么样的女子，是倔犟剽悍的，还是温柔娴雅的？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Something in between would suit me. And my lord?”

paragraphs.source_en: “I like gentle women, yet somehow I am never blessed with one.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Once peace comes to the realm, women will be even more inclined to make trouble. Still, peace is cause for rejoicing, so one must endure a little. Mother and Asahi are both of that sort. There is no need to take them too seriously!”
